1.e4 e6 2.d4 d5 3.Nc3 Nf6 4.Bg5 Be7 5.Bx.strategy: Gains space and drives the bishop back, but it costs White time and fixes the pawn on e5, where Black can attack it from both sides while keeping the bishop pair. The bishop has to retreat, since taking on e5 only loses a piece to the d-pawn. Playable, but it gives Black an easy game.
Retreats the attacked bishop and keeps it, so Black holds the bishop pair. The e5 pawn cramps Black, but the structure is solid and Black has natural ways to attack the pawn chain and free the game.
